big_picture.title: Stock Market Shows Resilience Ahead Of Thanksgiving Holiday; Anthropic Rises, Nvidia Sinks
big_picture.excerpt: After a poor start, the Dow ends in the black Wednesday while the Nasdaq and S&P 500 trim losses.
paragraphs: The stock market improved dramatically by the end of Wednesday's session after falling on a hotter-than-anticipated inflation reading, while signs of a booming economy firmed up bets for a December rate hike.
